open_questions: The license explicitly dates release August 2, 2026; HF repository creation in July is not treated as the public release date.
Exact pretraining objective, solver implementation, optimizer, data composition and training compute are not disclosed in the registered primary sources.
33B describes the Omni-Transformer including AdaLN branches, not the full encoder/VAEs pipeline; no full-system total or active-parameter count is asserted.
Sparse-attention training support must not be counted as published sparse inference kernels.

metadata.name: MiniMax-H3
metadata.license: MiniMax H3 Community License Agreement; see pinned LICENSE for terms. The Qwen3-VL-32B encoder is separately Apache-2.0.
metadata.variant_policy: Released H3-Base has separate CFG-distilled BF16 FL2VA and Ref2VA checkpoints. Full hosted H3 additionally uses unreleased Context-IR preprocessing and Regenerate-2K. This record distinguishes that mixed system from its open-weight base.

generation.scheduler: Published MiniMaxH3Scheduler configs: video shift=12.0; audio shift=3.0. Training objective and solver details are not specified by these configs.
generation.sampling: Released Omni-Transformer weights are CFG-distilled. No universal inference-step count is established by the registered card/config sources.

architecture.backbone: Dense single-stream H3-Omni-Transformer (MiniMaxH3DiTModel): 50 layers, hidden_size=5376, num_attention_heads=56, attention_head_dim=128, FFN width=14336, token_refiner_num_layers=2. FL2VA and Ref2VA structural configs are identical.
architecture.parameters: 33B Omni-Transformer parameters, including approximately 13B AdaLN-branch parameters. The card says AdaLN outputs can be cached so these branch weights need not be loaded for inference-only deployment. This is not a full-pipeline parameter total: the Qwen3-VL-32B encoder and VAEs are separate.
architecture.attention: Shared attention/FFN across modalities with modality-specific input/output and AdaLN branches; 3D MM-RoPE over time/height/width. Late-stage training uses native sparse attention, but the published initial inference implementation uses full attention; sparse kernels were promised separately.
architecture.conditioning: H3-Encoder uses full pretrained Qwen3-VL-32B weights and layer-50 hidden states. Text uses this encoder; visual inputs use both H3-Encoder and VisualVAE; audio uses AudioVAE. Packed multimodal representations condition joint prediction. Ref2VA accepts up to 9 images, up to 3 video clips (2–15 s each, total <=15 s), up to 3 audio clips (same durations), with <=12 reference files in total.
architecture.vae: Temporally causal H3-VisualVAE: f16t4d24 (16x spatial, 4x temporal compression, 24 latent channels). Transformer patches are [1,2,2], giving effective 32x spatial /4x temporal token downsampling. A ViT-based decoder is additionally trained after the encoder.
architecture.audio_codec: H3-AudioVAE independently processes left/right channels with shared encoder/decoder, then recombines stereo; 32 kHz per-channel audio becomes 40 Hz latents. Released config: latent_channels=32, output_channel=2, sample_rate=32000.
architecture.multimodal_coupling: One packed sequence and one Omni-Transformer jointly predict video and audio latents; separate visual/audio VAEs decode synchronized video and stereo audio.
architecture.implementation: Official checkpoint contains task-specific FL2VA/ and Ref2VA/ pipelines and component configs. The pinned card lists SGLang, vLLM, diffusers and ComfyUI integration guides; these are vendor deployment claims, not runtime validation in this repository.

output.resolution: Open H3-Base: 768p (default shorter side 768 pixels), multiple aspect ratios. 2K belongs to the separate hosted regeneration workflow.

training.pretraining: The card reports task-generalization capabilities from pretraining and native sparse attention introduced at the final training stage. Dataset sizes/mix, optimizer and loss formulation are undisclosed.
training.post_training: Released task-specific Omni-Transformer checkpoints are CFG-distilled; the distillation recipe is undisclosed.

precision.weights: BF16 released FL2VA and Ref2VA checkpoints

artifacts: FL2VA base checkpoint: text or optional first/last image to audio-video
Ref2VA base checkpoint: text plus image/video/audio references to audio-video
Qwen3-VL-32B-derived encoder, tokenizer, visual and audio VAEs; configs and deployment examples
release.hosted_scope: Context-IR relies on multiple hosted models/services and is excluded from the weight release. Regenerate-2K is also unreleased and accessed via API; the full official 2K workflow combines these hosted modules with local H3-Base.
limitations: Initial released inference provides full attention; sparse attention implementation is not included.
Released base alone does not reproduce the complete hosted 2K workflow.
Custom community license; openness here describes availability, not an OSI license classification.
